Six final model forecasts plus two additional SARIMA configurations were test-scored: initial differenced-scale output at 100.02%, diagnostic corrected output at 12.18%, and final SARIMA at 10.9969%.
PatchTSTModel was unavailable; TransformerModel was substituted, although artifacts retain the PatchTST label.
A batch_size=1024 Transformer rerun was stopped after roughly 18 minutes; the agent reverted to batch_size=512 and retained its completed cache.
N-BEATS encountered a 120-second command timeout and an orchestrator segfault; subprocess isolation enabled completion.

Other failures included an incorrect venv path, shell quoting, a missing quantile_timeseries API, unsupported MPS float64, Prophet module shadowing, and a missing common import during cache inspection.
An additional shell quoting failure at session.jsonl:174 had is_error=false and contained neither 'Traceback' nor 'Error:', so it is excluded from the prescribed failure count.
AGENTS.md was read before code creation but after a successful Python --version invocation.
Reported fit runtime of 1816 seconds excludes exploratory fits, failed attempts and the abandoned rerun; harness wall time was 6630 seconds.
one_line_summary: Compared six forecasting classes and chose LightGBM at 4.83% test MAPE, with pre-2020 validation and interval plots, but test-informed SARIMA revisions and no hourly forecast CSV.
